name: live_craft_per_player
description: The host gives the guest the ingredients for the first recipe in the data that needs no skill (any:noskill, the same on both peers). The guest crafts it twice at a bench. The crafting is the guest's own: the host spends and gains nothing, the guest's pack is the same on both peers, and the verdict is counted. The recipe-specific numbers are covered on a generated world by crates/world/tests/coop_interact_items.rs.
